cwe_content.cwe: CWE-22,Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

candidate.Reason: Extracts path components from zip entry names without validating against path traversal sequences (e.g., '../')
Creates directories based on zip entry names without sanitizing path traversal sequences, allowing directory creation outside intended location
Writes file contents to paths constructed from zip entry names without path traversal validation, enabling arbitrary file write
